name: Research-pack loop failed → stamp agent.run.outcome=failed on the run entity
description:
ADR-053 Phase 4a′ — the research-pack run-failed mapping. Fires when any non-budgeted research role terminates with an involuntary failure (agent.loop.outcome in [failed, truncated]) BEFORE emitting its decide() terminal. Stamps agent.run.outcome=failed on the RUN entity so agent-run/04 transitions executing→failed — otherwise the failed loop wedges the chain (e.g. a failed gather means research/03b-synthesize-when-all-gathers-complete never fires) and the run stays `executing` forever, the exact zombie this slice exists to kill.

This is the run-phase COMPANION to the existing research/08-loop-failed-pause (which stamps chain.paused.marker on the loop entity for the operator surface — left untouched). 08 surfaces 'this loop paused, look'; this rule advances the run lifecycle. They fire on the same event with different subjects (08: subjectless on the loop; 09: the run entity via the anchor override) and do not conflict.

ANCHOR (agent.run.entity-id): every research role (plan, gather, synthesize, reviewer-research) carries agent.run.entity-id — research is an unbroken loop-spawn chain from the run_scope=new dispatch coordinator (research/01), so the framework re-stamps agent.run.entity-id at every spawn (graph_writer.go:535-539). No research loop is spawned by a run-entity-fired rule, so none falls back to a lineage-only anchor — research needs no anchor split (unlike autoresearch/dev-via-test). This mirrors research/07's success stamp, which also uses agent.run.entity-id.

No budgeted-failure role exists in research (no execute/ralph analog), so the role list is exactly research/08's list.

metadata.companion_to: 08-loop-failed-pause.json (operator chain.paused.marker, untouched). This rule adds the run-phase transition.
metadata.anchor: agent.run.entity-id — framework-inherited on every research role via the loop-spawn chain (no run-entity-fired spawn in research). Mirrors research/07's success-stamp anchor.
metadata.cancel_out_of_scope: outcome list is [failed, truncated] (involuntary failure), NOT cancelled — cancel run-phase semantics are Phase 4b.
